verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine ships a programmatic Remote Control API, an HTTP and WebSocket server that can call Blueprint-callable functions, so per-agent scoped credentials are a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents issuing API keys, tokens, or least-privilege credentials for that API or any other Epic surface. Remote Control Presets choose which project content is exposed, but that is an adjacent exposure control, not credential scoping, so it earns no credit.
